response.sql:
WITH per_driver AS (
    SELECT r.driverId,
           SUM(r.points) AS points_total,
           AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
    FROM results AS r
    WHERE r.grid > 12
    GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total,
       AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps
FROM per_driver;

assumptions.assumption: A driver is included if they have at least one result with grid > 12; AVG ignores NULL laps, and SUM ignores NULL points.
